title: SWE-Stream: Scaling Executable Training Data for SWE Agents via Progressive Construction and Elastic Streaming
abstract: arXiv:2610.20193v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software engineering agents have advanced rapidly, but scaling their training remains constrained by the limited availability of high-quality executable tasks. Development histories contain valuable signals for constructing such tasks, yet they often require substantial reconstruction due to incomplete environments, missing tests, and inconsistent artifacts. We present SWE-Stream, a system for scaling executable SWE training data through progressive construction and elastic streaming execution. SWE-Stream progressively validates and refines task candidates, reusing existing artifacts when possible and applying targeted completion only when necessary. An elastic scheduler asynchronously coordinates construction stages under shared resource constraints, adapting execution budgets based on observed workload demands. Using development histories from 10,728 repositories across six programming languages, SWE-Stream constructs 80,874 validated

translated_title: SWE-Stream：通过渐进式构建与弹性流式执行扩展软件工程代理的可执行训练数据
translated_abstract: 软件工程代理发展迅速，但其训练规模的扩展仍受限于高质量可执行任务的稀缺。开发历史中包含构建此类任务的宝贵信号，然而由于环境不完整、测试缺失以及制品（artifacts）不一致等问题，往往需要进行大量的重建工作。我们提出了 SWE-Stream，一个通过渐进式构建与弹性流式执行来扩展可执行软件工程（SWE）训练数据的系统。SWE-Stream 对任务候选进行渐进式的验证与精炼，尽可能复用已有制品，仅在必要时才进行针对性的补全。弹性调度器在共享资源约束下异步协调各构建阶段，并根据观测到的工作负载需求动态调整执行预算。利用来自六种编程语言的 10,728 个仓库的开发历史，SWE-Stream 构建了 80,874 个经过验证的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SWE-Stream 提出了一种通过渐进式构建与弹性流式执行来大规模自动生成可执行软件工程训练数据的系统，从 10,728 个仓库的开发历史中构建出 80,874 个经过验证的训练任务。
en_tdlr: SWE-Stream is a system that scales executable SWE training data through progressive construction and elastic streaming execution, producing 80,874 validated training tasks from development histories of 10,728 repositories across six programming languages.
